notes:
Account snapshot: Orchid Scale Archives manages legal and historical records for multiple public institutions; aggressively moving to RAG for discovery + automated summarization. They plan to index 100M–1B+ vectors over 18–30 months.

Commercial posture: Enterprise procurement, heavy security and data residency needs. Primary interest in Dedicated pools with Private deployment option for initial tiered rollout. Very price conscious on 'per-query' after reranker stage.

Technical preferences / comments: two-stage retrieval (ANN embeddings -> learned reranker). Prefer embedding model family: open-source optimized embeds (OpenEmbed-v2 or local LLM-embed variants) with 8-bit/quantized storage. Using HNSW sharded across multiple clusters, want vector store hot/cold tiering. Plan: batch ingest 10–50M vectors/month initially.

Latency & throughput goals: p95 end-to-end (ann + rerank) <= 200ms for single-doc queries, p95 <= 400ms for multi-hop search; target sustained throughput 10k–20k qps for peak traffic, burst up to 50k qps.

Cost levers discussed: aggressive batching + request coalescing, prefix/KV caching for conversational use cases, reranker limited to top-50 candidates, quantized vector storage, warm/cold tiering to push majority to cheaper storage. Target blended cost-per-query: $0.0003–$0.0006 (after rerank).

Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, tenant-scoped KMS, proof of audit logging, retention controls and ability to keep PII on-prem. Data residency: primary repro in NA region with air-gapped archive for sensitive datasets.

Quotes and owner commentary: CTO (R. Marquez) — 'We can't justify >$1M ARR until the per-query unit economics are validated in production; must see repeatable <0.0005 cost w/ p95 SLAs.' AE Maya Chen — 'Can run 2-week dedicated POC: ingest 50M vectors, simulate 10k qps for 48h, measure p95 and cost breakdown.'

technical_requirements:
- Scale target: 100M–1B vectors; storage tiering required.
- Ingest: steady-state 10–50M vectors/month; peak bulk loads up to 150M.
- Retrieval: ANN + learned reranker at top-50; support batching of 128+ queries for offline/analytics; streaming for chat.
- Latency: p95 ANN+rerank <= 200ms typical; 95th <= 400ms for heavy queries.
- Ops: metrics + per-token/per-query cost breakdown, tracing to reranker, retention and audit logs.
- Models: ability to host quantized embedding models (8-bit/4-bit), reranker model isolatable to dedicated GPU pool.
cost_targets: Target blended unit cost after rerank: $0.0003–$0.0006. Will evaluate tradeoffs: reduce reranker calls (top-K tuning), increase ANN recall via higher-quality embeddings, adopt prefix/KV caching to cut repeated tokens. POC success metric = 25% lower cost than current self-host baseline and p95 latency within SLA.
deal_progress: POC parameters agreed; POC start conditional on execution environment (dedicated vs private). AE to finalize pricing and contract language; security to complete SOC2 scoping. Expected decision if POC meets metrics: procurement Q2 2026.
